title: Single tool call
prompt: What is the name and the country of the institution with GIIN 234BCD.00004.SB.132?
reference: lookupInstitution → Sponsored Subsidiary Two - Branch, located in Cape Verdi (as spelled in the list).

title: Search + count
prompt: How many institutions in the FFI list are located in Germany? List their names.
reference: 6 institutions: Test Bank Two; Sponsored Subsidiary One; Sponsored Subsidiary Two; Test Bank Four (two entries with different GIINs: 345CDE.99999.SL.276 and BBB123.00000.LE.276); Test Bank Ten, LLP.

title: Multi-step chain (rules → date math)
prompt: I e-filed my tax return on 2026-03-02. From which date can I start checking my refund status, and by which date should I expect the refund at the latest? Use the tools to compute exact dates.
reference: refundTimeline(e-file) → check after 72 hours, refund within 10–21 days. 2026-03-02 + 3 days = 2026-03-05 (check status from); + 21 days = 2026-03-23 (latest expected refund). Should mention Where's My Refund.

title: Search + calculation
prompt: What percentage of the institutions located in Denmark are branches? Round to one decimal place.
reference: Denmark has 5 institutions; 2 are branches (Test Bank Four - Branch, and the entry with a garbled dash 'Test Bank Four � Branch'), so 2/5 = 40.0%.

title: Two lookups and a comparison
prompt: Are the institutions with GIIN 456DEF.00002.BR.344 and 567EFG.99999.BR.036 located in the same country? Tell me both countries.
reference: No: 456DEF.00002.BR.344 (Test Bank Ten, LLP - Branch) is in Hong Kong; 567EFG.99999.BR.036 (Test Bank Eleven - Branch) is in Australia.

title: Handle a missing record
prompt: Give me the name of the institution with GIIN 999ZZZ.00000.LE.999.
reference: The lookup returns found=false: the answer must say that no institution with that GIIN is in the list, without inventing a name.

title: Restraint: no tool needed
prompt: What does the acronym GIIN stand for? Answer in one sentence.
reference: Global Intermediary Identification Number. No tool call is needed.
